message.content: Drones fly along corridors between named sites. Each site has only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time, so I have to check that there’s space before I send a drone. The authorities also define zones where flying is prohibited, and they can announce closures—either planned ones with a start and end time or sudden ones that apply right away. I have to make sure no drone flies through those zones or during closures, even if it’s already in the air when a closure happens.
